title: Start the 0.4.7 crash fix
text: A player on 0.4.7 gets a demand crash (worker 0: null is not an object, evaluating 'o.beside') many times since the update, mostly after making a new line (T-4367, P1). Your 11-25 word was to wind down with no new agents (usage 88%). Can I start one Opus agent on it now? I'd say yes. And does the wind-down still hold for everything else, or are 1-4 agents fine again?

title: Mansoura redraw
text: Mansoura's zone (9.2M over five governorates, wrapped round Aga and Birkat Al-Sab) goes back to Dakahlia and takes Aga (5.8M). Damietta's four districts join Damietta; Zifta and Santa join Birkat Al-Sab as a Zifta zone; Shibin al-Kum and Quwisna become a new Monufia zone; Samannud goes into El Mahalla as already agreed. Sheet artifacts/trainworld/review/redraws-1126-mansoura.png. Do it? redraws3 would.

title: Chiayi and Tainan redraw
text: Chiayi becomes Chiayi City and County whole (0.84M), Minxiong's zone goes into it, and Tainan takes all its own districts (1.75M); drawn together with Taitung's approved change. Sheet artifacts/trainworld/review/redraws-1126-chiayi-tainan.png. Do it? redraws3 would.
